admission.justification: No single layer guarantees seat identity alone: server registration without launch confirmation cannot block a misbound start, launch confirmation without brief self-check cannot catch post-start harness revival or lazy harnesses, brief self-check without zero-wake turn-end pass-through would be nudged back into work by silent-end wakes, and unspoofable sender attribution preserves trustworthy cross-seat evidence.

guarantee: A seat started by the product does work only under its own bound tool-server identity: each MCP server publishes its binding and process ancestry in a peer registry without altering legacy server inventory; eager launches and held-seat opens (including deferred held seats created on first role_message and legacy pre-created held seats) confirm one exclusive matching server under the seat's harness before sending the first message, retrying once on failure and refusing with zero live seats, and every opened held-seat role_message answer names the live execution.agentId as recipientAgentId and carries bindingConfirmation; every opening brief requires a first-action server_info self-check and silent termination with an IDENTITY MISMATCH: line on mismatch; the turn-end plug-in delivers that line verbatim to the parent with zero wakes so the parent archives, audits writes, and replaces the seat; and role_message derives sender attribution exclusively from the calling server's bound environment.
title: A started seat works only under its own identity
